classification: SYNTHETIC, DIMENSIONLESS, SOFTWARE-ONLY; LOCAL AND UNPUBLISHED

provenance.note: v1/v7/v8 source snapshots are vendored unchanged under compat/; no network write or publication was performed.

protocol.cluster_unit: payload_family x independent channel seed; replicate frames stay together in bootstrap resampling

condition_design.name: clean_control
condition_design.description: No channel distortion, timing/CFO/clock offset, or additive noise.

condition_design.name: static_sync_control
condition_design.description: Static off-grid timing, clock and CFO; no filtering or noise.

condition_design.name: colored_noise_only
condition_design.description: Stationary AR(1) additive noise (rho=0.80; marginal SD 0.25), no channel distortion.

condition_design.name: impulsive_noise_only
condition_design.description: Sparse impulse-Gaussian mixture (p=0.01; impulse SD 1.25), with Gaussian background SD 0.05.

condition_design.name: filter_frequency_selective_only
condition_design.description: Causal two-path FIR [0.82, 0, 0, 0.34], unit-energy normalized; no timing/CFO/clock offset or noise.

condition_design.name: fractional_timing_only
condition_design.description: Fractional timing offset +0.375 samples, otherwise clean.

condition_design.name: time_varying_cfo_clock_only
condition_design.description: CFO varies linearly from -0.003 to +0.003 cycles/symbol and clock rate from -100 to +100 ppm over the frame; trajectory mean is zero; no noise/filter.

condition_design.name: composite_unseen_channel
condition_design.description: Fractional timing +0.375 samples, linearly time-varying CFO (-0.003 to +0.003) and clock (-100 to +100 ppm), two-path FIR, AR(1) noise SD 0.20 plus sparse impulses p=0.005 and impulse SD 1.0 (background SD 0.04).

design.pairing: Each method in a condition received the same generated buffers; buffers are hashed in frame/cluster outputs.
design.uncertainty: Percentile bootstrap over independent payload-family x channel-seed clusters; all replicate frames in a cluster are resampled together.
